pages.title: First Plant of Filth
pages.text: Fertilizing poop blocks can occasionally produce a poop sapling.$(br2)Plant it on suitable ground and it will slowly grow into a poop tree.

pages.title: Growing Faster
pages.text: Poop saplings can also be fertilized with poop.$(br2)This does not always succeed on the first use, but it greatly reduces the waiting time.
